guignolDirectEvidence.fact: The accommodation page explicitly lists a théâtre de Guignol among Fenestre amenities and credits the Massif du Sancy tourist office as source. It names no company, repertoire, building, year of operation or date of opening/closure. Its illustrations were uploaded later; their upload paths are not capture dates.

A dated 31 July 2026 Guignol au cœur de la ville event is attributed to the Burattini family at Square Joffre, NOT Fenestre. The 1892 and 1968 tradition dates refer to the town/casino/company context, not proven Fenestre-item opening dates.
